item.description: দেশের আটটি শহরে নিরাপদ পানি সরবরাহ ও স্যানিটেশন অবকাঠামো উন্নয়নে ১৫ কোটি ডলার ঋণ দিচ্ছে এশীয় উন্নয়ন ব্যাংক (এডিবি)। বাংলাদেশি মুদ্রায় এ ঋণের পরিমাণ প্রায় ১ হাজার ৮৭৫ কোটি টাকা (প্রতি ডলার ১২৫ টাকা ধরে)। এ অর্থে প্রায় ৯ লাখ মানুষের জন্য পানি সরবরাহ ও স্যানিটেশন সেবার পরিধি বাড়ানো হবে। বিস্তারিত

item.title: Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor dies at home after prostate cancer
item.description: Former Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor died peacefully at home on November 23 after a long battle with prostate cancer, his family and the band said.

item.title: Higher blood pressure signals heart attack risk decades ahead
item.description: Researchers led by the University of Edinburgh found that higher systolic blood pressure and other warning signs can appear up to 30 years before a heart attack or stroke.

item.title: Peter Berg’s The Mosquito Bowl begins streaming on Netflix
item.description: The Mosquito Bowl, Peter Berg's film about a real football game Marines played on Guadalcanal during World War II, is now streaming on Netflix.

item.title: 1Password breach began with a hijacked employee GitHub account
item.description: 1Password says an attacker used a hijacked employee GitHub account to take administrative data about some customers, while customer vault contents were never accessed.

item.title: Grand Theft Auto VI draws over 39 million players on PS5, Sony says
item.description: Sony says more than 39 million unique players have played Grand Theft Auto VI on PS5, calling it the biggest game launch in PlayStation history.

item.title: NASA DART impact left Dimorphos tumbling with a stadium-sized crater
item.description: The first close-up images from ESA's Hera spacecraft show that NASA's 2022 DART strike flattened one face of Dimorphos into a stadium-sized crater and left the moonlet tumbling.

item.title: JonBenet Ramsey series trailer from Netflix sets up Dec. 10 premiere
item.description: Netflix released the trailer for The Murder of JonBenet Ramsey, a limited series starring Melissa McCarthy and Clive Owen that premieres on December 10.

item.title: Simulations hint at an Earth-class planet in the outer solar system
item.description: A peer-reviewed study published November 23 proposes an undiscovered planet of about 1.5 to 2 Earth masses, nicknamed Planet X2, orbiting far from the Sun.

item.title: US PCE inflation data shows a 3.8% annual rise for October
item.description: The personal consumption expenditures price index rose 3.8% from a year earlier in October, with core prices up 3.3% and personal income up 0.7%.

item.title: Blade Runner 2099 arrives on Prime Video with all eight episodes
item.description: All eight episodes of Blade Runner 2099, starring Michelle Yeoh and Hunter Schafer, are now streaming on Prime Video.

item.title: Mario Kart World update 1.9.0 adds replays and eight course variants
item.description: Nintendo's Mario Kart World update 1.9.0 for Nintendo Switch 2 adds automatic replays, two Knockout Tour routes and eight course variants.

item.title: DLSS 5 arrives in Where Winds Meet for Nvidia RTX 50 Series GPUs
item.description: Nvidia says DLSS 5 with 3D-Guided Neural Rendering is now available in Where Winds Meet on GeForce RTX 50 Series GPUs, RTX Spark devices and GeForce NOW Ultimate.

item.title: Pan-RAS pill ERAS-0015 posts 44% response rate in pancreatic cancer
item.description: Erasca said ERAS-0015 produced a 44% confirmed response rate in 25 previously treated pancreatic cancer patients taking 32 mg once daily.

item.title: Australian inflation climbs to 4.9% in October on housing and power
item.description: Australian inflation rose to 4.9% in the 12 months to October 2026, up from 4.3% in September, as housing and electricity costs climbed.

item.title: Moyin, 22, wins Great British Bake Off 2026 in Channel 4 final
item.description: Moyin Odeniran, 22, from Essex won series 17 of the Great British Bake Off on Channel 4, beating fellow finalists Tom Whittaker and Mo Mahir.
